notes: There has been a significant decrease by 39.1% in the number of cases of thefts of cultural property in 2001 over
2000. During the period 1913 cases of theft involving property worth Rs. 6.6 crores was registered. Recoveries were
made in 705 cases in 2001 where in the properties worth Rs. 4.5 crores were recovered. Details may be seen in Chapter8
